title: Gmail
description: Search and read Gmail messages and threads, send mail, save attachments into the organization workspace, and fire the gmail.message trigger when new mail matching the filters arrives. The add-on calls the Gmail API; the token is injected by the host and never enters the add-on process.

permissions.reason: Call the Gmail API with the bound account
Use the Google account bound to the mail connection
Save downloaded attachments into the organization workspace
Keep the resident poller that reads new mail from Gmail
Stay running to keep polling the bound accounts for new mail
Fire gmail.message instances for matching new mail

descriptor.title: New Gmail message
descriptor.description: Fires when a new message matching the filters arrives in a bound Gmail account

configFields.label: Gmail search query
configFields.help: Gmail search syntax applied by Gmail itself; empty matches every new message

configFields.label: Required labels
configFields.help: Comma-separated Gmail labels (system or user); a message must carry every listed label

configFields.label: Exclude terms
configFields.help: Comma-separated terms checked by the add-on against subject, sender and snippet; a message containing any of them is skipped (Gmail search cannot express this part)

sections.body: Connect a Google account in the connections section. The poller syncs new mail with the Gmail history API using a historyId watermark per account; when Gmail expires the watermark it falls back to a full search with the configured query and resets the watermark. Trigger instances match messages with the Gmail search query and required labels server-side; exclude terms are checked in the add-on. On the first sync of an account only the watermark is stored and existing mail stays silent.

descriptor.name: gmail
descriptor.title: Gmail tools
descriptor.description: Search and read Gmail, send mail, and save attachments to the workspace

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search Gmail with the Gmail search syntax (e.g. "from:alice is:unread newer_than:7d"). Returns id, threadId, snippet, subject, from and date per match.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10)

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one Gmail message: headers (from/to/cc/subject/date), the text/plain body, and the attachment list with attachmentId, filename, mimeType and size.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a Gmail thread: every message in order with headers, text/plain bodies and attachment lists.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a plain-text email from the bound account. to and cc accept one address or several comma-separated addresses.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Download a Gmail attachment into the organization workspace. Get messageId and attachmentId from the attachments list of read_message or read_thread. Files up to 6 MB are supported.

accountId.description: Bound Google account id; required only when several accounts are bound
